brief: A seven-cell honeycomb work surface, covered on top, with every open outside edge finished with caps.

requirements.evidence: 7x full pieces in honeycomb: piece:0,0,0;full (center) plus 1,0,0; 0,1,0; -1,1,0; -1,0,0; 0,-1,0; 1,-1,0 - center with 6 neighbors sharing edges, confirmed 18 outer edges
7x top covers fitted: cover:-1,0,0; cover:-1,1,0; cover:0,-1,0; cover:0,0,0; cover:0,1,0; cover:1,-1,0; cover:1,0,0 - one per cell, no remaining cover sockets

requirements.requirement: Every open outside edge finished with caps
requirements.evidence: 18x caps placed on all 18 outer walls (3 per outer cell: e.g. cap:-1,0,0;*;90/150/210 etc.), find_sockets cap now 0, meshClash clear, check_build ok:true
